question: By how many billion dollars is the Li-ion battery recycling market projected to grow between 2025 and 2030, and at what annual growth rate?

trace.query: SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, quantity FROM measures WHERE sentence LIKE '%LIB recycling market to grow%' OR text IN ('12.2','18.1','8.2%')
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role FROM measures WHERE page = 2 AND (text LIKE '%12.2%' OR text LIKE '%18.1%' OR text LIKE '%billion%' OR id LIKE 'p2.L56%')
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 2 AND id LIKE 'p2.L56%' OR (page=2 AND text LIKE '%billion%')

WITH t AS (SELECT string_agg(text, ' ' ORDER BY line_no) AS s FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p2.L56','p2.L57','p2.L58','p2.L59')) SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(s, '\$([0-9.]+) billion in 2025', 1) AS DOUBLE) - 0 AS base, CAST(regexp_extract(s, 'to \$([0-9.]+) billion by 2030', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS target, CAST(regexp_extract(s, 'to \$([0-9.]+) billion by 2030', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(s, '\$([0-9.]+) billion in 2025', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS diff, s FROM t
